# Nymrel MCP Hub (@nymrel/mcp-hub)
> Unified Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server for the Nymrel Autonomous Agent Stack

## Organization & Trust Graph
- **Brand:** Nymrel
- **Parent Entity:** JalenBuilds LLC (https://jalenbuilds.com)
- **Contact:** contact@jalenbuilds.com
- **License:** MIT 2026

## Overview
`@nymrel/mcp-hub` is a zero-dependency, dual-engine (TypeScript/Node.js + Python) Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. It aggregates 14 specialized agent tools, 3 live resources, and 3 workflow prompts for seamless integration with Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and OpenAI agents.

## 14 Registered MCP Tools
1. \`nymrel_ucp_audit\` - 7-layer AI Commerce Readiness & JSON-LD schema scorecard.
2. \`nymrel_surety_guard\` - Pre-execution destructive command firewall and path jail.
3. \`nymrel_swarm_claim\` - Distributed directory lock & lease coordinator with fencing generations.
4. \`nymrel_machine_trust\` - Schema.org JSON-LD parentOrganization entity graph and /llms.txt generator.
5. \`nymrel_proof_ledger\` - RFC-6962 SHA-256 Merkle tree execution attestation and proof generator.
6. \`nymrel_crawler_mesh\` - Clean web scraper & Markdown AST extractor for LLM token savings.
7. \`nymrel_beacon_ping\` - Liveness telemetry and multi-agent fleet heartbeat registry.
8. \`nymrel_headless_quote\` - Dynamic service quote calculator with Warm Paper tokens.
9. \`nymrel_local_forge\` - Local GPU / Ollama orchestrator & 3-tier model router (Luna/Terra/Sol).
10. \`nymrel_open_ucp\` - Universal Commerce Protocol x402 micropayments & AP2 cart negotiation.
11. \`nymrel_sandstorm\` - Zero-trust Copy-on-Write workspace isolation & secret token firewall.
12. \`nymrel_a2ui_render\` - Google A2UI v0.8 declarative JSON decision cards in Warm Paper tokens.
13. \`nymrel_swarm_bus\` - Studio task bus inter-agent message queuing and envelope dispatcher.
14. \`nymrel_proof_verify\` - Cryptographic Merkle receipt & digital signature validator.

## Resources
- \`nymrel://status\` - Real-time server health, uptime, and memory usage.
- \`nymrel://ecosystem\` - Catalog of all 14 Nymrel repositories and packages.
- \`nymrel://llms-manifest\` - Structured machine-readable guide for LLM context injection.

## Prompt Templates
- \`audit-website-ucp\` - Guided 7-layer AI Commerce Readiness audit.
- \`secure-agent-command\` - Command safety check with Surety and Sandstorm.
- \`init-two-seat-mission\` - Two-seat Command Studio setup.
